title: NeonWool
description: Makes wool a solid color to make pixel art look better. Now with RGB copper bulbs!
body: A Minecraft Texture pack originally for 1.21.1 that makes wool a solid color to improve pixel art. Compatibility is not strict, The 1.0.0 version should work in every Minecraft version that has wool. If you have 1.21 or later, I reccomend 2.0.0, it colors copper bulbs and makes wool look like windows 95. Enjoy building!
